notes: No datacenter projects found in Vikarabad district despite multiple targeted searches (data centre/datacenter/server farm/IT park, EN+US spelling). Telangana's hyperscale datacenter boom is concentrated in Ranga Reddy/Medchal-Hyderabad (AWS Bharat Future City at Mucherla/Chandanvelly, Microsoft 52-acre campus at Chandanvelly, CtrlS 40-acre at Chandanvelly, Web Werks Hyderabad) — none in Vikarabad. District economy is tourism/real-estate focused; no datacenter announcements located here.

No datacenter activity found in Wanaparthy district (rural district carved from Mahabubnagar). No datacenter/IT-infrastructure announcements located here; Telangana DC projects are all in the Hyderabad region.

No datacenter projects found in Warangal Rural district. Warangal city has IT services hubs (Tech Mahindra delivery centre inaugurated 2023; TSIIC IT Incubation Centre; state tier-2 IT hub programme) but these are IT/ITES facilities, not datacenters. No datacenter project (hyperscale or colocation) is located in Warangal Rural district.

No confirmed datacenter projects in Yadadri Bhuvanagiri district. Real-estate listings near Choutuppal market plots as 'near Microsoft Data Centre', but Microsoft's reported 52-acre campus is at Chandanvelly, Ranga Reddy district (per Wikipedia), and AWS's Bharat Future City campus is in Ranga Reddy — both outside this district. District hosts the 4,000 MW TSGENCO Yadadri thermal power station but no attached datacenter project was found.

No datacenter projects found in Dhalai district. All Tripura datacenter activity (Tripura State Data Centre at IT Bhavan, Indranagar; Smart City Mission data centre, both Agartala; NIXI-CSC international-standard data centre MoU, Agartala) is in West Tripura district, which is not part of this batch. Tripura Data Centre Policy 2021 provides state-wide incentives but no project is located in Dhalai.

No datacenter projects found in Gomati district (HQ Udaipur). Tripura's datacenter activity is confined to Agartala in West Tripura district (State Data Centre, Smart City DC, NIXI-CSC DC MoU); Tripura Data Centre Policy 2021 offers state-wide incentives but no project is located in Gomati.
